findings.reason: a second writer over the same file shape is the measured cause of the rolled-back relaunch, so the plan should name shard.py as the single owner the parallel engine extends.
findings.text: the plan introduces scripts/labeller_parallel/ as a writer "disjoint from scripts/labeller_batch/" that nevertheless produces the same per-shot session layout by re-implementing shard.py's label_shot admission/solve/persist path, and the fork already drifted: production job 1263815 ran HostRouteEngine and wrote two shots with zero converged slices (93 of 107 raising NoQualifiedAxisError) where shard.py converges about 65 percent, which f-pfs-045 then had to repair by proving identity against shard.py — the honest change is to extend scripts/labeller_batch/shard.py (which already has label_shot and is imported by the scheduler) with the batched/host engine and one writer, not to maintain two writers over one contract

findings.reason: the plan's own §2 names InverseDesign as the mechanism; the design should either extend it or factor one regularised-solve helper that both the pulse-design app and the shape inverse call, rather than a third copy per call site.
findings.text: §2 signals reuse of the pulse-design inverse step (InverseDesign.solve_current in nova/equilibrium/inverse.py) but the landed 1743-line shape_inverse.py does not extend it, re-deriving the Tikhonov-regularised least-squares solve with the same nova.linalg.regression.MoorePenrose call in at least three separate places (_turning_point_current_update at line 583, and two inline solves at lines 1425 and 1436), so the shared solving and row-assembly machinery is duplicated rather than lifted

findings.reason: placement is one of the named recurring duplicates; the app and launcher should resolve through FilePath so the run directory has one owner and one override.
findings.text: the app resolves its session directory and the launcher its allocation record with bare Path.home()/".local/share/nova/..." paths (apps/playable/main.py:280, scripts/playable_server/run.sh:75) although nova/database/filepath.py FilePath owns user-scoped path resolution and is what the rest of nova's stores use, so the playable app forks path handling

findings.reason: each section that grows the CLI or public-definition surface must account for that growth in its own text, or the plan cannot show the interface budget is being held.
findings.text: with the supplied counts at public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0, §7 adds three launcher options (--decoder, --machine, --view) and §8 adds --engine, and neither section states what it retires or merges or why nothing can be; the same sections add new public modules (shape_inverse, batched_labeller) with no retirement of the machinery they supersede

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — nova/equilibrium/batched_labeller.py (890 lines) hides the vmap/shard/branch-guard/masked-conditioning-pass over the compiled slice route behind a small engine interface, and apps/playable/session.py hides the solve/assemble/push/record keyframe lifecycle behind one session holder.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the plan adds a second labeller writer scripts/labeller_parallel/ that re-implements the per-slice admission, solve and persist contract owned by scripts/labeller_batch/shard.py.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §7 and §8 add CLI options (apps/playable/main.py --decoder/--machine/--view, scripts/labeller_parallel --engine) without naming anything they retire or merge, or why nothing can be.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the design sections cite the existing mechanism each new piece extends (InverseDesign.solve_current in nova/equilibrium/inverse.py, ControlPoints in nova/geometry/plasmapoints.py, nova/biot/contour.py Contour, FluxSurfaceGeometry in nova/equilibrium/flux_surface_geometry.py, the compiled slice route in nova/equilibrium/reduced_newton.py, and the pulse-design Bokeh view), and each of those mechanisms is present in the checkout.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the one genuinely thin layer, the FrameDecoder protocol in apps/playable/camera.py with its placeholder, carries its justification in §7 (the decoder is imas-ambix's, nova must not import imas-ambix), so it is not a wrapper that could have been an extension.
